title: fix(imessage): honor bound routes before agent selection
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where an iMessage conversation with a valid runtime binding fails ordinary multi-agent selection before its bound agent can be selected.

## Why This Change Was Made

Inspect the conversation binding first through the existing binding-owner API. For an authoritative bound agent, derive only its session scope before projecting the captured binding facts. Ordinary and configured routing remain the fallback for unbound conversations.

The inbound caller awaits resolution and preserves the current `ConfiguredBindingRouteResult`, including configured-binding readiness. Activity persistence cannot silently replace the captured owner: the existing final reply-admission boundary rejects revoked, reassigned or unavailable bindings before reply generation or delivery.

This reconstruction changes only four iMessage files. It does not restore the historical shared helper or add an SDK surface, configuration, schema, or sibling-channel change.

## User Impact

Bound conversations reach their selected agent even with an ambiguous roster or conflicting ordinary route. Unbound and configured conversations retain their existing behavior; an unavailable binding owner fails closed.

## Evidence

- Published reconstruction: `af1877ff0e31e11142d1156e0ee30ff8346e54af`, tree `6d401da6de4683aefeb1e005c364ae9ceaff715a`, based on reviewed main `2f10ac3c1342396e0ec82d8a8fd5a9d2ebaed704`.
- [Remote causal and candidate proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36191697649): the selected baseline case fails with the intended `AgentSelectionRequiredError` at ordinary routing; 14 unrelated cases are filtered.
- All 22 repaired route/inbound cases pass, including real public reply dispatch with unchanged, revoked, reassigned and unavailable bindings. The unchanged reply-owner sibling suite passes 30/30. No candidate or sibling cases are skipped.
- Complete four-path `check:changed` and base-relative `git diff --check` pass, including production/test types, formatting, extension lint, SDK/boundary guards, dead exports, storage and import checks.
- [Earlier remote formatting and lint](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36190977688) passed; its baseline-name selector matched zero tests and correctly stopped before qualification. The missing-leg run corrected the Vitest name-filter separator mismatch without weakening the exact selected-case oracle or replaying standalone formatting/lint.
- Raw JSON report hashes, source restoration and all 204 frozen dependency inputs were independently verified. Both owned proof leases completed and command handles joined. Actions cancellation during delegated lease cleanup is not the application result; the final wrapper receipt is exit 0 / succeeded.
- Full scoped P0-P2 AutoReview and independent source review found no actionable defect. A live-main comparison at `e06986400ce6412953908596886245cb3a4b08f7` confirms both touched production owners still match the frozen baseline.
- This is fixture-backed routing and real internal reply-admission proof, not a live Apple/iMessage account round trip. Required exact-head CI and native preparation subsequently passed; see the disposition below. Merge remains pending.

## Provenance

This remains @vincentkoc's original PR. The original head `c9cabc27cde7b5641ca613a1564b3aa416f6d055` is retained as an ancestor through a normal fast-forward update. Historical SDK and runtime proof is not substituted for this reconstruction's evidence.

Historical provenance:
- Punchcard-Session: coral-valley-summit-qv
- Punchcard-Commit-Attestation: att_01M0CMBQQJ3VZT22787B42QPP7
- Punchcard-PR-Attestation: att_01M0CMDPA1AQNV2RNM4AX61F3Y

## Maintainer Disposition: Adapter Outage

Retain fail-closed routing for both bound and unbound conversations while the adapter owner is unavailable. An unavailable owner is not authoritative evidence that a conversation is unbound; falling through to another agent would violate the [existing binding contract](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/af1877ff0e31e11142d1156e0ee30ff8346e54af/docs/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins/sessions-and-bindings.md#L72). This accepts delayed delivery during that outage, including for conversations with no saved binding, and selects the accept-and-document option in the [completed ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/123159#issuecomment-5288626594).

The unchanged [monitor catch](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/af1877ff0e31e11142d1156e0ee30ff8346e54af/extensions/imessage/src/monitor/monitor-provider.ts#L583) abandons the pre-adoption claim and logs the original dispatch error. The [queue owner](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/af1877ff0e31e11142d1156e0ee30ff8346e54af/src/channels/message/ingress-queue.ts#L1145) retains the payload as pending, increments attempts and records turn-abandoned; existing draining/backoff makes it eligible for another attempt. This is source-backed recovery eligibility, not a demonstrated outage-to-recovery Apple delivery trace.

Important inherited limitation: this catch calls errorless abandon, so it does not enter the generic onFailed dead-letter classifier. No bounded retry-exhaustion outcome or eventual sender-facing failure notification is claimed. Existing message-age fences still apply. Improving error-aware abandonment and adding complete bound/unbound outage-to-reply coverage belong to a separate ingress-owner follow-up; this four-file routing repair does not change queue schemas, retention or retry policy. The outage behavior and that limitation are accepted for this landing; the review's optional recovery expansion is not represented as completed proof.

Measured remote costs from the retained raw reports: conversation-route 15/15 cases, 142 ms suite time; inbound route 7/7, 1.150 s; unchanged reply-owner sibling 30/30, 48.291 s. Process elapsed time including preparation was 28.492 s for both changed files and 86.191 s for the sibling. These are single-run measurements, not a speedup claim.

Exact-head [required CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36193070703) passed at af1877ff (26 successful jobs, 23 skipped); the [aggregate gate](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36194013184) passed. Native review and preparation completed at the same head. ClawSweeper's fresh completed review has no actionable code/security findings; its owner-choice and test-cost requests are dispositioned here. Merge and remote source verification remain pending.
